skill: Work backward from a remaining fraction
stem: A container was initially full. Two-fifths of its water was used, then one-third of the remaining water was used. If 24 liters remained, how much water was in the container at first?
solution_steps: After using 2/5, the fraction left is 3/5.
Using 1/3 of the remainder leaves 2/3 of that remainder.
Final fraction left = (3/5)(2/3) = 2/5. Therefore (2/5)x = 24, so x = 60.
rationale: The second fraction applies to the remainder, not to the original amount.
high_yield_takeaway: When a fraction is taken from the remainder, multiply successive remaining fractions.
source_use: Original item inspired only by the competency patterns in the uploaded references; no source wording is reproduced.
takeaway: When a fraction is taken from the remainder, multiply successive remaining fractions.
